name: Gemma 3 4B IT (multimodal)
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, and the vision side is the most expensive-per-image design in this slice. (1) Vision: SigLIP tower, 27 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 896, vision_use_head false, gelu_pytorch_tanh. NO POOLING, NO MERGE, NO RESAMPLER. VISION TOKENS = (896/14)^2 = 64*64 = 4,096 tokens for ONE image -- the largest single-image vision token count of any model here, 64x SmolVLM's 64 and 2x Pixtral's single 1024 tile. Gemma 3 compensates with pan-and-scan (optional multi-crop at inference), which multiplies the 4,096 figure. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES ABSOLUTELY. 4,096 vision tokens against a typical 100-300 token text prompt is 15:1 to 40:1. On any single-image Gemma 3 request, the SigLIP forward pass and the LLM prefill over 4,096 image tokens -- not the decode loop -- are the entire cost. (2) LLM: Gemma 3 text decoder, 34 layers, hidden 2560, 8 heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 256 (note: head_dim 256 is 4x the hidden_size/num_heads of 320, so it decouples head width from model width), intermediate 10240, query_pre_attn_scalar 256, vocab 262,208, max_position 131,072. ATTENTION: sliding_window 1024 with 5-local-to-1-global layer interleaving -- the sliding layers cap attention cost while the global layers preserve long-range. ARCHITECTURE = dense (both parts dense). CONTEXT_SCALING: rope_scaling {factor 8.0, rope_type linear} on top of rope_theta 1e6 -- simple linear position interpolation, not YaRN or NTK-aware. The 131,072 figure is therefore an extrapolated context, not a natively trained one. KV CACHE: 34 * 4 * 256 * 2 * 2 = 139,264 B/token (136 KiB). IMPORTANT: in a real Gemma 3 serving stack only the 6 global-attention layers hold full-length KV; the 28 sliding layers hold at most 1,024 tokens each. A correct paged-KV implementation should therefore store roughly 34 -> ~6 full layers plus 28 capped, cutting effective resident KV by roughly 5x versus this headline number. This is the single most important serving caveat in this record and it is invisible in config.json alone. params_b 4.300 = HF API safetensors total (4,300,079,472); vision tower is ~0.4B of it. PROVENANCE: google/gemma-3-4b-it is license-gated (raw config.json returns HTTP 401). Every field here was read from the unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it mirror, and the param total was cross-checked against the gated repo's own HF API entry.
